post.description: Check credentials and set the session cookie.

get.description: Called by the frontend on startup to tell guests from logged-in users (401 = guest).

post.description: Create an account and log in immediately (sets the session cookie).
Create a room right away (criteria come later). The creator becomes the host.

get.description: Polling endpoint. If since_version == room.version, returns changed=False with an empty body.

post.description: Host ends voting early: the most-liked place wins (decided_by="host").
Join the lobby. 409 if the room already started, is full or the name is taken; 410 if expired.

get.description:
Public, no token: status, host name and member count, so the join page can explain a room
that cannot be joined (expired, started, full) before asking for a name. 404 if unknown.

post.description: Host only: fetch candidates from the CandidateProvider, store them, move to voting.
Upsert a vote, then apply rules.decide; the room may be decided in the same transaction.
One best place + up to 3 backups. With USE_STUB_MATCH=true it returns sample data.

get.description: List stored FoodMaps places and real coordinates for the public home map.

schema.title: Response Map Places Api Match Places Get

post.description:
'Not Match': reorder the backups the client still holds by the reason given.

The first place of the response is the new best; the rest are the new backups. The server keeps
no state: send the place_ids of the backups that are left in `remaining`.

get.description:
AI Summary, pros/cons, answers to the preset questions and most mentioned dishes of one place.

Written offline by `scripts/generate_insights.py` and only read here. 404 `insights_not_found`
= the place exists but has no insights yet (hide the block); 404 `not_found` = unknown place.

'Why this place?': 3-4 short bullets from the reviews that fit what the user typed.

The bullets are written offline by `scripts/generate_insights.py`; here they are only chosen by
embedding similarity to `mood`, so no LLM is called. Empty `points` = the place has no insights yet.
Every place reduced to what the home map needs to draw a pin.

schema.title: Response Map Places Api Places Map Get

get.description: Basic facts about one place (404 `not_found` when the id is unknown).

Visible reviews written on the website, newest first (guests allowed).
`is_mine` marks the caller's own.

Internal reviews imported from the team's form are not listed; they only feed Match and Analysis.

post.description:
Write a review. 409 if the caller already reviewed this place (edit it instead); 429 if too fast.

A review that trips the text filter is saved with status `flagged`: only its author sees it.

get.description: Review Analysis: 4 aspect scores, most mentioned dishes, pros/cons, tags (guests allowed).
The caller's own review of a place (any status). 404 = they have not reviewed it yet.

put.description: Replace the editable fields of the caller's own review. Not rate limited.

post.description: 'Báo cáo' button. One report per person per review; 3 different reporters flag it.

schema.title: Response My Saved Places Api Saved Places Get

post.description: Save a place (201). Saving an already saved place moves it / updates the note (200).

get.description: The user's lists with place counts. The default list is created on the first call.

schema.title: Response My Lists Api Saved Places Lists Get
